name: @temporal-tides/nexus-intro-scratch
description: Nexus intro open-room playable: Ink rules + Three.js chamber (not part of root docs build)

scripts.compile: node node_modules/inkjs/bin/inkjs-compiler.js -o story.json nexus-intro.ink && node -e "const fs=require('fs');let t=fs.readFileSync('story.json','utf8');if(t.charCodeAt(0)===0xfeff)t=t.slice(1);fs.writeFileSync('story.json',t);fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('story.json','public/story.json');"
